items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A backup group! Isn’t that something? And it was. We did, it was a hell of a group, and a lot of fun.

ctx.x: A backup group! Isn’t that something? And it was. We did, it was a hell of a group, and a lot of fun. Oscar Peterson…
